AdapterDescriptor.title: AdapterDescriptor
AdapterDescriptor.description: Typed, content-addressed adapter document: identity, category (the per-category contract implemented), and the capability binding served.

AdapterDescriptorVersion.title: AdapterDescriptorVersion
AdapterDescriptorVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized adapter descriptor (currently 1).

AdapterId.title: AdapterId
AdapterId.description: Registered adapter identifier: "adapter:" followed by a lowercase kebab slug.

CapabilityCategory.title: CapabilityCategory
CapabilityCategory.description: Capability Fabric adapter category: source, semantic, reconstruction, visualization, simulation, evaluator, action, or verification.

CapabilityBinding.title: CapabilityBinding
CapabilityBinding.description: Which capability (opaque, stable id) at which version range an adapter serves.

VersionConstraint.title: VersionConstraint
VersionConstraint.description: Version range an adapter declares it serves: an exact pin, or caret major-version compatibility (npm-caret semantics incl. the 0.x carve-outs).

SemverCore.title: SemverCore
SemverCore.description: Semantic-version core (major.minor.patch, digits only, no prerelease/build suffixes).
